root.label: Sudanese refugee sues Frontex over Libya abuses

events.label: Sudanese refugee sues Frontex over Libya abuses

slots.name: filing date
slots.sentence: In 2024, he sued Frontex with the help of lawyers from the legal activist group Front-LEX, the advocacy group Refugees in Libya and the German nongovernmental organization Sea-Watch.

slots.name: plaintiff age
slots.sentence: “I have tried many times to escape from here but I was not lucky because of Frontex and their allies” in Libya, said the 31-year-old refugee, whose full name was not disclosed for safety reasons.
